annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1410 of 4 July 2023 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for sterilization of health care products and biological evaluation of medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1410 of 4 July 2023 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 as regards harmonised standards for sterilization of health care products and biological evaluation of medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 170/102
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision amending the list of harmonised standards supporting the Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/745, adding the amendment to EN ISO 25424:2019 on sterilisation and EN ISO 10993-10:2023 on skin sensitisation testing. Compliance gives presumption of conformity. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex of Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1182 is amended
EN ISO 25424:2019/A1:2022 reference added for sterilisation
EN ISO 10993-10:2023 added as entry 17 for skin sensitisation tests
Compliance with listed standards gives presumption of conformity with MDR 2017/745
Enters into force on day of publication
